basics.name: Shamsuddin Ahmed
basics.label: Senior Software Engineer
basics.summary: Senior Software Engineer at Mevrik and founder of AlgolyzerLab. Five-plus years building scalable backend systems, production ML infrastructure, and agent harnesses in Go and Python — plus research on machine learning for peptide prediction and drug discovery.

work.summary: AI-powered customer-experience platform serving telecom operators and 700+ SMB customers.
highlights: Work across the AI surface of the product: conversational agents, retrieval, and the model serving infrastructure beneath them.
Author feature specifications and technical documentation for engineering teams and leadership.

work.summary: Applied-AI studio for sports science, healthcare, agriculture, and research engineering.
highlights: Athlete Intelligence — multi-tenant athlete performance management for elite sport (Go, Next.js 16) with an IOC-aligned clinical domain and an RTMPose GPU pipeline that turns ordinary video into clinical movement metrics.
ChemberIQ — medical case-management platform (Go/Gin, Vue 3, offline-first Flutter doctor app) with a purpose-built in-memory search engine.
Agri Remedy — drone-based crop-disease monitoring using DINOv2 features with staff-trained linear-probe heads and bilingual treatment guidance.
Cricket Bowling Analyzer — 18-parameter biomechanical analysis from video with ICC elbow-extension compliance checks and PDF clinical reports.
Deployed Qwen 3.5 27B (INT4 and FP8) on vLLM for production workloads serving 1,000+ concurrent users; tuned throughput via continuous batching, KV-cache sizing, and quantization strategy.
Built an OpenAI-compatible LLM Gateway (FastAPI, httpx) with rerank support, error enrichment, and benchmark endpoints across multi-tenant workloads.
Implemented page-index RAG combining layout-aware region extraction with vector retrieval.
Built an edge-vision pipeline with YOLO on NPU hardware for real-time anomaly detection.
Developed multi-agent services with LangGraph and Dify including human-in-the-loop review; shipped tool integrations over MCP.
Designed legal-tech RAG systems; improved retrieval quality through chunking, embedding selection, citation prompting, and reranking.
Fine-tuned LLMs with LoRA/QLoRA (Unsloth); led the internal R&D track on agents and retrieval.
Architected a multi-tenant AI orchestration platform (FastAPI, Vue 3, PostgreSQL/pgvector, Docker) with a DAG workflow engine and SSE streaming.
Built ML-powered recommendation microservices in FastAPI with caching and background jobs.
Improved API responsiveness through query refactoring and pagination; added integration tests.
Automated CI/CD pipelines with Docker; hardened REST and GraphQL APIs with monitoring and structured logging.
Worked on IoT-integrated backends for sensor data ingestion and device communication.

publications.name: AIPpred-Stack: Prediction of Anti-Inflammatory Peptides using Ensemble Learning with an Experimentally Validated Dataset
publications.summary: A two-stage stacking ensemble combining ~2,282 hand-crafted sequence descriptors with 1,280-dimensional ESM-2 protein language model embeddings. Replaces the random-UniProt negatives used by prior work with experimentally validated negatives from IEDB T-cell assays, producing a harder and more honest benchmark. With Abdullah Al Mamun and Francis M. Bui, University of Saskatchewan.

portfolio.name: Reins
portfolio.description: A lightweight agent harness you bolt onto an existing app: intent-named capabilities derived from your functions or ORM models, reads and writes separated in code, writes gated by policy, approval, and audit.

portfolio.name: Veldra
portfolio.description: A self-hostable, local-first agent-harness platform where an agent is data, not code — a versioned AgentSpec row interpreted by the runtime. MCP connectors, editable RAG knowledge bases, agent teams, and feedback-driven self-improvement.

portfolio.name: DeepNatProtease
